feeds.description: Hello, I'm Eshé the lady behind the blog. Foodie Eshe is a Brighton food blog and insider's guide to where to eat across Brighton & Hove, with a focus on independent restaurants. On this blog, you'll find honest reviews of restaurants, cafes, supper clubs, takeaways, and pop-up restaurants in Brighton, as well as all the latest news on the new openings.
